Service · AI Enterprise Agents

An AI agent that actually knows your product.

I design and build specialized AI agents for enterprise software: in product copilots for your customers, or internal agents that help your teams run a complex platform. Development shops build the plumbing. I build the part people trust: when the agent acts, when it asks, how it explains itself, and how it stays inside your design system.

Book a call See pricing

2 to 3 weeks

to a designed, scoped agent

30 to 60 days

to a working pilot on one workflow

One owner

from UX strategy to shipped behavior

Most agent projects fail on experience, not on models.

The demo works. Then real users meet it, and the problems show up in the places nobody designed.

  • A

    Nobody defined how much the agent should do on its own.

    So it either asks permission for everything or quietly does too much. Both erode trust within a week.

  • B

    It does not look or behave like your product.

    The agent UI gets bolted on. It ignores your tokens, components and voice, and it feels like a different vendor.

  • C

    No one can tell if it is getting better.

    Without evaluations and success metrics, every prompt change is a guess, and leadership cannot see the return.

  • D

    It is a black box to users and to compliance.

    In healthcare, government technology and finance, an agent that cannot show its sources and reasoning never gets past review.

Built for your customers, or for your people.

Type 01 · Customer facing

In product copilot

An agent inside your SaaS product that helps customers get to value faster: setting things up, finding answers in their own data, completing multi step tasks, and explaining what it did.

For product leaders who want an AI story customers will actually use.

Type 02 · Internal

Platform operator agent

An agent that helps your employees run a complex enterprise product: configuration, reporting, triage, onboarding, and the knowledge that lives in three people’s heads.

For operations and transformation leaders who need measurable time saved.

AI speeds up the mechanical work. People make the calls.

Especially in regulated industries, the most credible agent is the one that knows its limits.

01

Human in the loop by design

Approval gates, undo, and clear handoffs to a person are designed in from day one, not bolted on after the first incident.

02

Explainable by default

Sources, confidence and the steps the agent took are visible to users and auditable by compliance.

03

Native to your system

The agent UI uses your tokens and components, so it looks and behaves like your product, not a widget from someone else.

Small first, then bigger. You can stop after any stage.

Ask about this

Prices are in USD. Rates may vary by client and scope of work, and final pricing is confirmed in a written proposal before work begins. Backend integrations are delivered with your engineering team or a vetted build partner. Model and hosting costs are billed to your accounts at cost.

Things people usually ask.

Do you build the backend too?

I lead agent design, orchestration (skills, prompts, tools, evaluations) and the agent UI. For deep integrations I work alongside your engineers or bring in a vetted build partner, so you get one accountable lead without agency overhead.

Which models and platforms do you use?

Whatever fits your security posture and stack: Claude, OpenAI, Azure, Bedrock or Vertex, with MCP for tool access. The design and evaluation work carries over if you switch models later.

What if the pilot does not work?

Then you find out in eight weeks instead of six months. The readout tells you why, and what would need to be true for it to work.

Who owns the result?

You own your agent, prompts, data and UI. I keep my underlying framework and license it to you, which is part of why this costs less than starting from scratch.
